also.hook: Tripathi has spent his career on the unglamorous but consequential work of making health data actually move between systems, first from the policy side as the U.S. government's top health IT official, and now from inside a leading hospital system, applying that same interoperability and governance discipline to how AI gets deployed in clinical care.
also.name: Micky Tripathi
also.moniker: Federal Architect of Health AI Policy

also.hook: Ambrozie has led digital transformation at three of the largest consumer-facing organizations in America, Ford, Disney Parks, and now CVS Health, bringing consumer-experience engineering discipline to bear on making AI-driven healthcare personalization work at national scale.
also.name: Tony Ambrozie
also.moniker: Healthcare's Digital and AI Transformation Executive

profiles.hook: Reis-Filho built his career deciphering cancer genomics at the bench, at the Institute of Cancer Research and then as Chief of Experimental Pathology at Memorial Sloan Kettering, before moving to AstraZeneca to apply AI foundation models and agentic frameworks directly to drug discovery and clinical development, one of the clearer examples of a working oncologist becoming an enterprise AI leader.
